source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Check if NVMe RAID rebuild LED function works normally
1. Insert NVMe SSD into BP slot and check present LED

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Check system spec define LED function

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: Generic Locate command plus visual Rebuild LED confirmation.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: LED command result and physical observation.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; offers Locate, which neither starts nor observes rebuild, and overlooks the Present-versus-Rebuild mismatch.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; surfaces the mismatch and requests degraded array, replacement member, trigger, completion and recovery definitions.

original_test_intent: Nominally validate an NVMe RAID rebuild indicator during an actual controller rebuild, but the authoritative procedure instead tells the operator only to insert an SSD and inspect the Present LED; the executable intent is therefore unresolved.
original_method: Preserve both source paths pending owner resolution: either (A) establish a degraded approved RAID array, insert the correct replacement and observe controller rebuild plus Rebuild LED, or (B) perform a simple insertion/Present LED check. They are not equivalent and must not be combined silently.
manual_activity: Either interpretation would require physical SSD insertion and visual LED inspection. No such action may begin because the source does not identify which physical indicator and state transition are actually being accepted.
required_inputs: Owner decision selecting Rebuild LED or Present LED scope
If Rebuild: controller/RAID level, degraded array, replacement SSD, auto/manual rebuild trigger and accepted phases
If Present: approved SSD, bay and insertion power-state procedure
Exact LED color/pattern/timing and bay/enclosure mapping
Array/data disposition, backup, OOB and recovery/rebuild policy
safety_requirements: Do not invent a degraded array or trigger a rebuild from the title alone.
Do not accept a Present LED as Rebuild evidence or use Locate for either function.
Never insert or assign a member to boot, protected, data-bearing or unknown storage.
Physical insertion requires approved hot-plug/ESD procedure and exact serial-to-bay mapping.
No automatic rebuild, cancel, force, retry or recovery action.
agent_execution_scope: Preserve the contradictory source facts and prepare separate evidence plans for the two interpretations.
After an engineer resolves the intent, validate the selected topology, targets, tool and safety gates.
Automate controller state/log capture only within the approved interpretation.
Never claim physical LED evidence or PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Resolve whether the case tests Rebuild or Present LED and correct/approve the authoritative expected state.
Supply and approve the selected physical/storage topology and recovery plan.
Perform the physical action/observation and assign the verdict after execution.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not applicable: Locate is a third LED function and cannot resolve or test either conflicting source path; `/c0` and enclosure assumptions are unverified.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: No state-changing or LED command should be issued until the source owner selects the intended function; then use controller-native read-only rebuild telemetry or presence inventory as appropriate.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The item, rebuild statement, insertion/Present step and 10/5-minute fields are all preserved verbatim as conflicting evidence.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: If Rebuild is confirmed, correlate degraded baseline, replacement insertion, controller rebuild phases and physical Rebuild LED. If Present is confirmed, remove rebuild claims and correlate insertion with Present LED only.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Exact controller/backplane/LED design after intent resolution.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record controller, backplane/CPLD/BMC firmware and utility versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Platform LED truth table and controller rebuild behavior documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the mutually exclusive interpretations explicit rather than fabricating a hybrid.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Proceeding now could mutate an array while collecting evidence for the wrong indicator.

project_override_considerations: A project override may select one interpretation, but it must explicitly document that choice and cannot rewrite the master source or claim the omitted path was tested.
expected_evidence: Case-specific owner resolution and selected LED truth table
Approved topology/member/bay map and physical action plan
For Rebuild: degraded baseline, trigger/progress/completion and controller events; for Present: insertion/enumeration events
Operator-attributed LED media, post-health, Tool Result and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The item and opening line require Rebuild LED, while the only numbered step checks Present LED after insertion and provides no degraded array, rebuild trigger or rebuild state. These functions and stimuli are materially different.

blocked_analysis.analysis: This is a genuine necessary-operation ambiguity, not merely a missing project parameter. Executing either path could yield an irrelevant result or initiate unsafe array state changes; owner resolution is required before execution.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects the unrelated Locate shortcut and its failure to notice the source contradiction.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Adopts its conflict finding but strengthens the outcome from conditional partial to BLOCKED until the core operation is selected.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Uses BLOCKED only for the genuine semantic impasse and retains both source facts without rewriting them.

review_improvement: Stops an ambiguous LED case from being executed against live RAID state and makes the exact owner decision auditable.
independent_technical_reasoning: Rebuild, Present and Locate indicators arise from different controller/backplane conditions. No safe automation plan can infer which condition the source intended, so classification must remain BLOCKED despite both possible paths being technically feasible after resolution.
no_automatic_retry: No execution or retry is permitted before the source owner resolves the intended LED and rebuild semantics.
